paragraphs.source_en: Seeing that Ankokuji had already fallen into the trap, Mitsunari lowered his voice. “Once this rumor spreads, people will naturally ridicule you, Reverend, as a man who used affairs of state to avenge a private grievance. These rumors would not only destroy the good name you have built over a lifetime; I, Mitsunari, would also be swept into the raging torrent, and the world would surely condemn me as a shameless wretch seeking to satisfy his own ambition.”
